subject.title: Feature Request: Scoped / Script-Limited Agent Mode (Cost-Controlled + Predictable Execution)

question: What native scoped-automation contract should OpenClaw expose for cron/script-limited agent runs, and which components should be split to existing narrower trackers?
rationale: The issue asks for new execution, budgeting, and security semantics that cannot be safely inferred from current partial primitives or automated as a strict bug fix.

options.title: Design Shared Native Mode
options.body: Define one maintainer-approved scoped automation contract spanning cron/hooks/tool policy/budget admission/run receipts, then split implementation into reviewed component PRs.

options.title: Split Into Component Trackers
options.body: Close this umbrella only after assigning each requested capability to canonical open issues such as budget enforcement, dry-run, tool scoping, and cron schema work.

options.title: Plugin Packaging After Core API
options.body: Route optional workflow packaging to plugins or ClawHub only after core exposes the missing security and accounting seams.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Native Mode
recommendation.body: Define one maintainer-approved scoped automation contract spanning cron/hooks/tool policy/budget admission/run receipts, then split implementation into reviewed component PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and adjacent runtime history make steipete the strongest available owner for the product/API direction choice.
